data.narrative:
General Biological is a Series A–stage biotech company founded by Abhi Godavarthi and David Sozanski, having raised $6.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparables universe of 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage companies including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Of three valuation methods examined, only stage-progression proved applicable. This method uses the $6.6M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage progression, yielding an implied value of $13M. Peer-median anchoring was not viable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting screening criteria (fewer than three datapoints). Public-comp pricing multiples cannot be deployed because the target's revenue is not disclosed, a common constraint for private companies. The public sector median P/S multiple stood at 6.2x across the three biotech tickers, but lacks applicability absent revenue data.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $11M to $15M, with a median of $13M. This range is anchored to a single method and therefore carries material uncertainty around stage assumptions and forward growth rates. Key unknowns include the company's proprietary technology scope, clinical or preclinical stage, and burn profile—factors that typically drive substantial variance in early-stage biotech valuations.
